main_text.p: fint, tum quòd à se inuicem in infini-tum varient atque distent.

Posita verò sacramentorum inter se in infinitum distantia, cùm infini-tarũ rerum nulla disciplinabilis queat esse comprehensio, fieri non potest vt de sacramentis quicquam certi tra-datur aut percipiatur. Idem de fortuitis & contingētibus est iudicium, è quibus nihil firmiter concluditur.

Deo autem, qui rectissimo consilio, ordine, numero, pondere & mensura cōdidit & administrat vniuersa, quo-modo potuit quippiā institui fortu-itum, præsertim ad solennem ipsius cultum? Sunto sanè sacramenta Deo autori suo arbitraria, vt pro illius sapientia & voluntate, quotiescunque lubitum est, mutentur: quemadmodum legimus in Testamento veteri, pro temporis atque populi ratione, plura diuersaque Legis fuisse sacramenta, quæ postea sub Testamento nouo defierunt, referēte Augustino, in pauciora numero, actu faciliora,

page.notes: Stray dot before "modo" at the start of the line "quo-modo", probably a printing speck, left out. "institui" in the scan is printed with a dotted i; read as "institui". Printing spacing is irregular in places (for example "autem ," and "est,mutentur") and is left as printed. The reference "c. iiii." stands alone below the text and is set as a foot paragraph.
